items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пр҃о. Въ въсѧ землꙗ. Сти. Нб҃са повѣда ють. Апл҃ь. Де҃ ѕ҃. Аллуа. Іереи твои. Еѵе ѿ Матѳ. Ноꙗб к҃г. Регь: Вы есте свѣ. Кн҃ Въ въсѧ землꙗ. Ст҃ыи чюдотворець, и бесре брьникъ. Кѵра, Іѡа. Ве. Ст҃ры. с҃. на ѕ҃. Сл҃ гл҃ и҃. Двоица мч҃нкъ. Ін҃ б҃. На сти. ѡ҃.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):* *Having received the gift of wonders from divine grace, O holy ones, ye work wonders unceasingly, cutting down all our passions as by surgery, invisibly and mightily, glorious Cyrus with John: for ye are divine physicians!*

items.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Divine Liturgy: of the forefeast, Ode 3; and of the martyr, Ode 6.*[^390]
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: Customary Kathisma psalmody, and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the feast. Anabathmoi of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "I will remember Thy name in every generation" [LXX Ps. 44:18]; Verse: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, as at the Divine Liturgy on the feast, from midday, which hath the beginning: "There was a man in Jerusalem..." [Lk. 2:25–32]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the feast. Canon of the feast, as written here, Tone 3: the heirmos twice, and the troparia on 4; and again the heirmos by both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the feast, Tone 1, Idiomelon...*[^392]
items.office: At the Divine Liturgy: of the forefeast, Ode 3; and of the martyr, Ode 6.*[^390]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: и роуцѣ блг҃слви сѵмѣѡнѣ. ꙗко подобаше. прѣ варивъ, и нн҃ѣ сп҃слъ еси насъ х҃е б҃е. нѡ оу҆ми ри въ бранехь житїе наше. но оу҆крѣпи кнѧ- зꙗ и҆же възлюбилъ еси едїне чл҃колꙋбь че: ~ На ѳ҃. чт҃нѣишю не стїхослови и даю тсѧ свѣщи бран. По ѳ҃. свѣ. празникꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Meeting, Tone 1, Idiomelon:* Thou Who didst sanctify the Virgin's womb by Thy birth, and didst bless the hands of Symeon, as was meet, having anticipated us, Thou hast now also saved us, O Christ God; but give peace to our life amidst wars, and strengthen the prince whom Thou hast loved, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

В ь коу празникꙋ. и ст҃мꙋ. А҆ ще в по. то дне вное. Кѡ҃ с҃тго. гл҃а д҃. Ꙗко велие сл҃нце цр҃кви. и чюдесы лꙋчами просвѣщаеши въ сегда. вселенѣи исполненїе. нб҃ныи таебь инчи есидоре прп҃бне: ~ Стыꙗ мч҃нци, А҆га фїи. В к҃оу. самогласень. гл҃ и҃. Пресла вное чюдо бысть. Кѡ҃ гл҃а в҃ к вышнихь.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Показавыи кр҃та бж҃твеныи ѡ҆бразъ. на не беси. сꙋщаꙗ на земли наставити. къ тво е́му познанїю Х҃е б҃е, днь просиꙗ невечернꙗꙗ свѣтлость. свѣтлища твое́го. на пазнамена сѧ. того оу҆ковенїи малдь вѣрнїи. ѡ҆роужїе мироу. непобѣдимоую побѣдж: ~ Ст҃го все ленскаго. и прехвалнаго еѵ҆лїста. а҆пл҃а, Іѡанна Бг҃ослова. и прп҃бнаго ѡ҆ц҃а нашего.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Apparition of the Cross, Tone 8:* The image of Thy Cross hath now shone forth brighter than the sun, which Thou didst stretch out from the holy mount unto the place of the Skull; and in it Thou hast made manifest Thy strength, O Savior, and by its power Thou hast strengthened our faithful rulers; save them ever in peace, through the prayers of the Theotokos, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Арсенїа великаго. Празднꙋемь в е҃ днь. Пѣ нїемъ въсенощное. На малои вечерни. Стр҃ы а҆пл҃оу. на д҃. Сл҃ гл҃а в҃. На гробова: ~
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Apparition of the Cross, Tone 4:* O Christ God, Who didst show the divine image of the Cross in the heavens to guide those upon the earth unto Thy knowledge: today the unwaning radiance of Thy luminary hath shone forth; upon us it was signed; therefore, possessing it as our hope, we faithful reign, an invincible trophy and weapon of peace!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. Stichera on 8: 5 to the apostle, 3 to Arsenius; Glory: "Son of Thunder..."; Both now, of the feast, of the same tone. Entrance. Prokeimenon of the day. 3 Lections from the general epistle [1 Jn. 3:21–4:6; 4:11–16; 4:20–5:5]. At the Litiya: idiomela to the apostle 4, Tone 1: "The river of theology...", "The branch of purity...", "The disciple of the Savior...", "He who is ineffable..."; Tone 2: "A virgin...", "He who of the apostles, O Theologian..."; these are sung. Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]. 2nd [idiomelon]: Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father..."; Verse: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Glory, Tone 4: "Thou didst lean..."; Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: after the Octoechos, to the apostle, Tone 6. Verses sung: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5], "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. Glory, Tone 6: "Apostle of Christ and Evangelist..."; Both now, of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4: "O Virgin Theotokos" twice; and of the apostle once: "Beloved apostle...". Blessing of the Loaves. And a reading from the Apocalypse. At Matins: Troparion of the feast twice; Glory, of the apostle; Both now, of the feast. Customary Kathisma psalmody; Sessional hymns of the feast, and the Polyeleos... ...[Their sound is gone out into all the] earth. Tone 4, Prokeimenon: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from John [Jn. 21:15–25]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the apostle. Canons: of the feast on 4; to Arsenius on 4; and to the apostle on 6. But if on this day there is no afterfeast, then of the feast on 6, and to the apostle on 8; Katavasia: the heirmos of the feast. After Ode 3, Kontakion to Arsenius, Tone 3:*
items.office: Glory, and now, of the feast. At Matins: afterfeast and of the Cross to 6. Kontakion of the Cross, Tone 4
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сл҃ і н҃ пра о҆кте ѿпꙋ. И даетсѧ ст҃ое масло пое́мъ высѧ гл҃ико. а҆ ча. На лѵ҃ а҆пл пѣ г҃ и ѕ҃.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Venerable Arsenius the Great, Tone 3:* From Rome thou didst shine forth as a great sun, and didst reach the imperial city, O most blessed one, enlightening it with thy words and deeds, driving away all mist of ignorance; therefore we honor thee, O glory of fathers, venerable Arsenius!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃гочтиваго костантїна . і҆ н҃ы . Тр҃о . пр҃о . гл҃ и҃ . Кр҃та твоего ѡ҆бразъ на нб҃си видѣвъ . и҆ ꙗ коже паоулъ званїе не ѿ чл҃къ прїемь . и҆же въ ца рехъ апл҃ъ твои г҃и . цр҃твоующїи градъ въ роу цѣ твои прѣложи . егоже сп҃саи всегда въ ми рѣ мл҃твами бц҃а . едине чл҃колꙋбче : ~ На оу҆р҃ни ка҃ ст҃ым на ѕ҃ . По ѕ҃ . пѣ кѡ҃ гл҃а г҃ .
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Holy Equals-to-the-Apostles Constantine and Helena, Tone 8:* Having seen the image of Thy Cross in the heavens, and like Paul having received his calling not from men, Thine apostle among kings, O Lord, placed the imperial city into Thy hands; which save Thou ever in peace, through the prayers of the Theotokos, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: Customary Kathisma psalmody, and the Polyeleos. Sessional hymns of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, Friday of the 2nd week [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the saint. Canons: of the Theotokos, Tone 8: "Holding fast amidst many temptations...", with heirmoi on 6; and of the saint on 8. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the saint. After Ode 6...*[^403]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: гл҃ в҃ . Бж҃твеную . і҆ н҃ б҃ тр҃о гл҃а , д҃ : ~ Ꙗко бж҃твеное скровище . скровено въ земи хс҃ ѿкрыль е҆ . главоу твою намъ пр҃рче . и҆ пр҃тче вси бо съшедшесѧ къ томоу ѡ҆брѣтенїе . и҆ единого гл҃ыиди сп҃саемь . сп҃сающаго насъ ѿ тлѧ мл҃твами твоими : ~ сл҃ і҆ н҃ . б҃ На оу҃ . Ѡ҆ бы стїсловие и҆ многомл҃тивыи . Сѣ пр҃тчи сте҃ гл҃ д҃ про҃ гл҃ д҃ . тоу възвращꙋ рогъ . ст҃ Помѧни г҃и дв҃да . Всѧкь ды . Еѵ҆лїие . ѿ Ма҃ въ кто . ѕ҃ , н҃е . ѱалѡ҃ н҃ . стра҃ прѣдътечи кано҃ въц҃ и҆ прѣтечи . на ѕ҃ . по ѕ҃ пѣ . кѡ҃ прѣтечи . д҃е к҃д . прр҃че бж҃ии . на хвалите побники , г҃ . прѣтечи на д҃ . сл҃а гл҃ ѕ҃ . все чт҃ную . і҆ н҃ б҃ . славословїе великое . тр҃о прѣ течи . слава . і҆ нн҃ѣ б҃ . сѡ҃ктеꙗ . ѿпоустъ .
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Third Finding of the Head of the Forerunner, Tone 4:* As a divine treasure hidden in the earth... ...Christ hath revealed thy head unto us, O prophet and Forerunner; for all of us having gathered together at its finding, with harmonious voices hymn the Savior, Who saves us from corruption through thy prayers!*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆же ѡ҆ на҃ . Бездноу ꙋченїи бг҃ословїа . и҆ сточилъ еси ꙗвѣ ѡ҆ источничь сп҃совь . е҆реси попалѧющи кириле . и҆ стадо неврежено тре волненїи избавлѧющи . странахъ ты еси прѣ подобне наставникъ . ꙗко бж҃твнаа ꙗвлꙗꙗ .
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of St. Cyril of Alexandria, Tone 6, Podoben: "He Who fulfilled the dispensation for us..." (Иже о нас):* An abyss of teachings of theology thou didst openly pour forth from the springs of the Savior, burning up heresies, O Cyril, and preserving the flock unharmed, delivering it from tempests; thou art a guide unto lands, O venerable one, as one revealing divine things!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Apostle Barnabas, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):* Thou wast a true servant of Christ, and didst appear as a leader of the Seventy, having been together with Paul... ...proclaiming with right teachings the coming of the Savior; therefore we honor Thy godly memory, O Barnabas, glorifying thee!*

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Venerable Peter of Mount Athos, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest..." (Къ вышнимъ):* *Troparion: "O God of our fathers..." [Tone 4]. After Ode 3, Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest..." items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Venerable Onuphrius the Great, Tone 3:* *After Ode 6, Kontakion [of Venerable Onuphrius], Tone 3:* Illumined by the radiance of the All-Holy Spirit, O divinely wise one, thou didst forsake the turmoil in this life; and having reached the desert, O venerable father Onuphrius, thou didst gladden the God and Creator of all; therefore Christ, the great Bestower of gifts, glorifies thee, O blessed one!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Martyr Aquilina, Tone 2:* With the beauties of thy virginity thou didst honor thy soul, and didst ascend unto the height of martyrdom, O all-glorious Aquilina, being wounded with love for Christ the Bridegroom; unto Whom thou now standest before with the angels, rejoicing; together with them pray unceasingly for us all!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. Stichera on 8: idiomela 4, doubled, Tone 4: "When the Word of God was pleased...", and 3 others; Glory, Tone 6: "The day of light..."; Both now, Tone 8: "Elizabeth conceived...". Entrance. 3 Lections. At the Litiya: idiomela 3, Tone 1; Glory, Tone 6: "Among the prophets..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: idiomela 3, Tone 2; and they say verses: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel" [Lk. 1:68]; "And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest" [Lk. 1:76]; Glory, Tone 8: "Isaiah..."; Both now: "In the days of Elizabeth...". Troparion: "O prophet and Forerunner...", is sung twice; "O Theotokos and Virgin...", once. Blessing of the loaves, and reading. At Matins: Troparion of the Forerunner twice... ...Glory, and now, Theotokion: "The mystery hidden from all eternity..." [Tone 4]. Customary Kathisma psalmody, and the Polyeleos. Sessional hymns of the Forerunner. Anabathmoi of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest" [Lk. 1:76]; Verse: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel" [Lk. 1:68]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:24–25, 57–68, 76, 80]: "At that time, Elizabeth conceived...", seek at the Liturgy, from the midpoint. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the Forerunner. Canons: of the Theotokos with heirmoi on 6; and two of the Forerunner: one in Tone 6 [in the Octoechos]: "An angel of God...", on 4; and the other in Tone 4, by John the Monk, on 4; or if they wish, let them sing the first on 8. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2:*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: No Kathisma psalmody. Stichera 3 to Peter and Paul, and 3 to the Synaxis; Glory, Tone 4: "Christ, willing first..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: prosomoia 3; Glory: "The all-honorable..."; Both now, Theotokion: "Thou art a vine blossoming...". The same troparion of the apostles is sung 4 times; Glory, and now, Theotokion. At Matins: ordinary Kathisma psalmody. Sessional hymns of the Apostles. Canons: first to Peter and Paul, both on 8, and to the Twelve on 10, and on 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the Synaxis, Tone 2:*

At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord..." [LXX Ps. 115:3]. Epistle: see September 27. Alleluia: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]. Gospel from Matthew [Mt. 11:27–30]. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: сла́вныꙗ · всѧ́ ѡ҆ста́виста ꙗ҆́же въ житїи при́кныꙗ · і҆ ꙗ҆́редлъ є҆́го прие́мъши · и҆ с вон крⷭ҇- -ть на ра́мо възъе́мша · подража́телѧ того житїю́ бы́ста · бж҃твеныꙗ сла́вы є҆го прича́- -стникы · і҆ѡа́нне бг҃о́мꙋдре · съ сѵмеѡ́нѡмь чю́дны[мъ] · мл҃ита непреста́нно ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́[съ] :~

Kontakion, Tone 2:* Inflamed with the love of Christ, O glorious ones, ye abandoned all things in this earthly life... ...fleeting, and having accepted His yoke and lifted the Cross upon your shoulder, ye became imitators of His life, partakers of His divine glory, O divinely-wise John with marvelous Symeon: pray unceasingly on behalf of us all!*

Unto Christ, Who for our sake was born of the Virgin, honorable Magdalene, thou didst follow, keeping His ordinances and laws; therefore rejoicing we celebrate thy most holy memory, praising thee in faith and honoring thee with love!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. Stichera of the saints on 6; Glory of the saint [Christina], Tone 2: "As an alabaster flask..."; Both now, Theotokion. Entrance. Prokeimenon. 3 Lections, see [September] 26, written for the Theologian. At the Aposticha: 3 prosomoia of the saint; then Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; and idiomelon, Tone 6: "Come, let us praise..."; Glory, Tone 2, of the saint: "Unto the named after Christ..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion of the Martyrs [Tone 4]: "Thy martyrs, O Lord...". At Matins: Troparion of the saints twice; Glory of the saint; Both now, Theotokion. Ordinary Kathisma psalmody... ...and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the saints, Tone 4. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 12:2–12]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Verse: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; and Idiomelon, Tone 8: "Despising bodily pleasures...". Canon of the saint [Christina] with the heirmos on 6, and of the saints [Boris and Gleb] on 8. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint [Christina], Tone 4:*

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Passion-bearers Boris and Gleb (Roman and David), Tone 3:* Today hath shone forth the all-glorious memory of you both, the martyrs of Christ, Roman and David, calling us together unto the praising of Christ our God; therefore running unto the shrine of your relics, we receive the gift of healing... ...for ye are divine physicians! Exapostilarion. At the Praises: 3 prosomoia of the saint [Christina], and 3 of the saints [Boris and Gleb]; then Verse: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; and Idiomelon of the saint, Tone 5: "Thy virginal..."; then another Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; and Idiomelon, Tone 6: "Today, ye faithful..."; Glory, Tone 8: "The first-newly-illumined [rulers]..."; Both now, Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the saints; Glory, and now, Theotokion. Litany, Dismissal, and the 1st Hour. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the saints, Ode 3 on 4, and of the saint, Ode 6 on 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Unto the saints that are in His earth hath the Lord been marvelous" [LXX Ps. 15:3]; Verse: "I foresaw the Lord always before me" [LXX Ps. 15:8]. Epistle to the Romans [Rom. 8:28–39]: "Brethren, we know that to them that love God all things work together for good...". Alleluia: "The righteous cried, and the Lord heard them" [LXX Ps. 33:18]. Gospel from John [Jn. 15:17–16:2]: "The Lord said unto His disciples: These things I command you...". Kinonikon: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: stichera of the saint on 6; Glory, Tone 4: "Today hath shone forth..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: 3 verses: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]; idiomela, Tone 1: "A noble contest..."; Glory, Tone 5: "Come together, ye lovers of martyrs..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; Verse: "In the congregations bless ye God" [LXX Ps. 67:27]. Epistle: lection 25 [2 Tim. 2:1–10]. Alleluia, Tone 4: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]. Gospel from John, lection 52 [Jn. 15:17–16:2] after Pascha. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*[^442]

items.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 6, of the Cross: "The prophetic voice..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: of the Cross, and of the saint
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Before the ringing of the bells, the priest enters with the superior of the church and with the candle-bearer into the skeuophylakion, and taking up the Precious Wood with candles and with a censer, singing the Troparion: "Save, O Lord, Thy people", and they bring it into the church and place it upon the Holy Table, and they kindle a candle by the Precious Wood for the whole evening. The ordinary kathisma psalmody. At "Lord, I have cried": stichera 3 of the Cross, and 3 of the saint; Glory, Tone 8: "Holy Maccabees"; Both now, of the Cross, Tone 8: "He Whom of old...". At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 8: "The souls of the righteous..."; Both now, of the Cross: "The voice of Thy Prophet...". Troparion: "By the sufferings of the Holy..."; (see fol. 24)[^448] Glory, Both now: "Save, O Lord, Thy people". At Matins: Troparion of the Cross... ...On that day is sung the office of Saint Maximus; stichera of both... Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father..."; Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion... (see fol. 11);[^449] Glory, Both now, of the feast. At Matins: canons of the feast on 6, and two... After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 2:*

items.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: On the 11th day: Of the Holy Martyr Euplus. At Vespers: of the feast and of the saint. Troparion and Kontakion of the feast
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 12th day: Of the Holy Martyrs Photius and Anicletus... ...twice; Glory, of the saints; Both now, of the Cross. The ordinary kathisma psalmody; and reading in the Theologian [St. Gregory Nazianzen], as is customary. And in the refectory is read "Prepitan" concerning the saints. Canons: in the Octoechos on 4; and of the saints on 4; and of the Cross on 6. Katavasia: "Cross did Moses trace". The canon of the Cross is sung after, for the sake of the Katavasia. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest..." (Вышнихъ ищя):*[^453]
items.office: On the 11th day: Of the Holy Martyr Euplus. At Vespers: of the feast and of the saint. Troparion and Kontakion of the feast
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Словословіе вѣкое . Поющи же браи . іереи сѡ блачит ся . въ вѣтинь священническыи . и при ходи с кадило[мъ] . и с лампадою . къ ст҃ѣи тра пезѣ . и кади ст҃ую трапезꙋ . и чт҃ное древо . и и ѡболченъ еерею . поюще тро҃ . сп҃си ги҃ люди своꙗ . въскращенне люще . Ст҃го первому в҃ ченника стефана : архидиакона . ве҃р по ѡки ст҃го . г҃ и҃ г҃ самогланки . гл҃ в҃ . сл҃ гл҃ ѕ҃ пръ воводі і҃ н҃ . ко҃ на сти҃ ѡ . сл҃ гл҃ и҃ . Раꙋися ѡ г҃ѣ і҃ ны . ко҃ тро҃ гл҃ д҃ . Цр҃скою діади мою вѣнча ся твои връхъ ѡ сїтра̄нии . ихже притръпѣ по хѣ бз҃ѣ . мч҃нко пръвостра̄лне ты бо іюдеемъ ѡбличилъ еси гнѣвъ . видѣ своего сп҃са ѡ десною ѡц҃а . того оу҃бо моли присно сп҃сти ся всѣмь намъ :~ на оу҃ кано҃ ѡ и ст҃го на ѕ҃ . по ѕ҃ . кѡ҃ гл҃а ѕ҃ . самогланъ .

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пръвыи нѣс҃я ся на земли небесныимъ дѣ лателемъ всехвалне . пръвыи крьвь за х҃а на земли излиялъ еси блажене . первы и ѿ него побѣдныимъ вѣнцемь ѡдѣꙗ ся на небесѣхъ . ꙗко страдальцемь пръвовъхо дныи . квенечнителю оученникомъ пръво страдалне :~ на хвалите . подобникы .
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen, Tone 6, Idiomelon:* First wast thou sown upon earth by the Heavenly Husbandman, O all-praised one; first didst thou pour out thy blood for Christ upon the earth, O blessed one; first wast thou adorned by Him with a crown of victory in the heavens, as the first-risen among sufferers, the crown-bearer of disciples, O first-sufferer![^457]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: prosomoia... ...and of the saint on 4; Glory, Tone 4: "Good Stephen..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 5: "First-martyr..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord" [LXX Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear, O God, my prayer" [LXX Ps. 63:2]. Epistle from the Acts [Acts 6:8–7:5, 47–60]. Alleluia: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]. Gospel from Luke, lection 53 [Lk. 12:32–40]: "The Lord spake this parable: A certain man...". Kinonikon: "Into all the earth [their sound is gone out]" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Иже въ мїрѣ ꙗко тлѣнна преꙁрѣвши . и не тлѣнныꙗ дары приꙗсте . бестлѣнна пре бысте оумръше . ѿноудоуже и въскръноу сте . по мноꙃѣхъ лѣтѣхъ . вся погребше прелестникъ вѣрьсткныꙗ . ꙗже въ хвалахъ дн҃е вѣрнии въспѣвающе х҃а благодари[мъ]:~
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Seven Youths of Ephesus, Tone 4:* *Kontakion, Tone 4:* Having despised the corruptible things in the world and received incorruptible gifts, ye remained incorrupt after dying, wherefrom also ye arose after many years, having buried all the ferocious deceit of deceivers; therefore praising them today, we the faithful in hymns give thanks unto Christ![^458]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Troparion of the feast thrice. Ordinary psalmody [Kathismata]. At the Polyeleos: Sessional hymns of the feast, and reading from the books of St. John Chrysostom, Homilies 56 and 57.*[^464] *Gradual, Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Thy name" [Ps. 88:13]. Verse: "Thine are the heavens" [Ps. 88:12]. "Let every breath..." Gospel from Luke [9:28–36]: "At that time, Jesus took Peter [and John and James]..." And we kiss the Gospel. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" we do not say. Two canons: of master Cosmas [Tone 4] and of master John [Tone 8]; heirmoi twice, and troparia four times. Katabasia: "Tracing the Cross," both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 7, Idiomelon:*[^465]
items.office: At Matins

items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Forefeast:* O ye people, dance beforehand, clapping your hands with faith and love, gather yourselves together today, rejoicing brightly, shouting all together with gladness; for the Mother of God is about to pass over gloriously from earthly things unto the heights; whom with hymns as the Mother of God we ever glorify!

Въ ржтвѣ двыство , съхранила еси . въ оуспеніи мли ра не ѡставила еси бце . преставлена къ животоу . мт҃не щи живота . мл҃твами тво ими избавляеши ѡт съмр҃ти дш҃а нша :~

items.section: Three readings for the feast. At the Litiya: Idiomela 3, Tone 1, Tone 2, and Tone 3; Glory, Tone 5: "Come, ye lovers of the feasts"; And now: "Sing, O ye people." On the Aposticha, Idiomela, Tone 4; and speak the verses: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest" [Ps. 131:8]; "The Lord hath sworn unto David" [Ps. 131:11]; Glory, and now, Tone 4: "When thou wentest forth, O Mother of God..."

Gospel from Luke [1:39–49, 56]: "In those days, Mary arose..." Sticheron of the feast, Tone 6: "When the passing..." Two canons: of master Cosmas [Tone 1] and of master John [Tone 4]; heirmoi twice, and troparia on 12; afterwards the heirmos of both canons both choirs together once. After Ode 3, Hypakoe: "All generations shall call thee blessed." After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2.*

Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "There will I make the horn of David to bud" [Ps. 131:17]; Verse: "Remember David, O Lord" [Ps. 131:1]. "Let every breath..." items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Beheading of the Forerunner:* The glorious beheading of the Forerunner was a certain divine dispensation, that he might preach even unto those in Hades the coming of the Savior; let Herodias weep having asked for lawless murder; for she loved not the Law of God, nor eternal life, but deceit that is temporal!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion. On the Praises, of the Forerunner on 4; Glory, Tone 6: "Again Herod..."; And now, Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Forerunner; litany, dismissal; and holy oil is given to the brethren from the lamp of the Saint. At the Liturgy: for the Forerunner, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall rejoice" [Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear my voice, O God" [Ps. 63:2]. Epistle from the Acts [13:25–32]: "In those days, as John fulfilled his course..." Alleluia: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [Ps. 91:13]. Gospel from Mark [6:14–30]: "At that time, Herod heard of Jesus..." Communion Hymn: "In everlasting memory [shall the righteous be]" [Ps. 111:6].*[^499]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: ordinary psalmody [Kathisma]. Stichera in the Menaion on 6; Glory, and now, Tone 2: "As a crown..."; on the Aposticha, of the Oktoechos; Glory, and now, Idiomelon, Tone 2; Troparion: "O Theotokos, Ever-Virgin..."; and Hypakoe twice. items.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: The sequence of the Saint in the Menaion is sung at Compline, or whenever [the ecclesiarch] wills
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Sunday evening: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 6: in the Octoechos 3 of the current tone, and in the Menaion 3. On the Aposticha, the Octoechos is not sung; there is sung the daily Automelon 2 and 4, in the same Tone 5, once, both choirs together; Glory, both now, Theotokion. Thus sings the stichera at Vespers during the other days of Cheesefare week. But let it be known that on Cheesefare Saturday and Sunday the Menaion is not sung, but the sequence of the Saints whose memory is accounted... ...accounted on Saturday and Sunday is sung at Compline, or whenever the ecclesiarch wills.*[^521]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Sunday evening: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 6: in the Octoechos 3 of the current tone, and in the Menaion 3. On the Aposticha, the Octoechos is not sung; there is sung the daily Automelon 2 and 4, in the same Tone 5, once, both choirs together; Glory, both now, Theotokion. Thus sings the stichera at Vespers during the other days of Cheesefare week. But let it be known that on Cheesefare Saturday and Sunday the Menaion is not sung, but the sequence of the Saints whose memory is accounted... ...accounted on Saturday and Sunday is sung at Compline, or whenever the ecclesiarch wills.*[^521]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Monday of the First Week, at Matins:*[^534] *at "Alleluia," Hymns to the Trinity in the tone of the week. After each Kathisma [psalmody], sessional hymns in the Menaion and in the Triodion. There are chanted the First, Third, Sixth, and Ninth Hours, with psalmody and with prostrations. Then we chant Vespers: "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [Ps. 103]; Glory, both now; "Alleluia" thrice, and 3 prostrations. We recite the psalmody: "In my distress I cried unto the Lord" [Ps. 119; Kathisma 18]. On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 6: 3 in the Triodion, and of the Saint 3 in the Menaion; Glory, both now, Theotokion; "O Gladsome Light." Prokeimenon before the Old Testament reading, and Genesis is read, the first reading. Another Prokeimenon, and the Proverbs of Solomon are read. Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord," and prostrations... ...3 prostrations. And both choirs having come together, they chant the daily Automela 2 and 4, in the same tone, once; Glory, both now, Theotokion. "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart in peace..."; Trisagion; and 3 prostrations; Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; Troparion: "Theotokos Virgin, rejoice..."; Glory: "O Baptist of Christ..."; Both now: "Intercede for us..."; and after each troparion, one prostration; then: "Beneath Thy compassion...", without a prostration. "Lord, have mercy" 40 times, quietly and evenly. The priest exclaims: "O God, be merciful unto us..."; and we make 3 great prostrations with the prayer: "O Lord and Master of my life..."; and the remaining 12 metanias; and at the last prostration, that entire prayer: "O Lord and Master of my life." Trisagion; and 3 prostrations; after "Our Father...", "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Blessed be the name of the Lord" thrice; and 3 prostrations; Glory, both now; "I will bless the Lord [at all times]"; and the dismissal. After this, we go out into the narthex, singing according to custom the sticheron of the Saint. And the priest says the customary prayers and the departure [litany], and the priest commemorates [the departed] with all the brethren; and there is the complete dismissal. This order of Vespers takes place in...*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Подобаеть вѣдати · ꙗко не приꙗхѡ стварѧ ти преждесщ҃еныꙗ до среды · понеже по пре данію ст҃ы ѡц҃ъ постатѧсѧ браꙗ всѧ до сре ды · могоущіи же до пѧтка · Егда же бꙋ деть преждесщ҃енаꙗ · Бываеть вечернѧ си це · по бл҃ви дꙋше моꙗ г҃а · сл҃а і н҃ а҃ллꙋа г҃ ·
items.english_cohort_translation: *Whenever there is the Presanctified [Liturgy], Vespers takes place as follows: After "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [Ps. 103], Glory, both now, "Alleluia" thrice, and 3 prostrations; the Great Litany, and the exclamation. And we recite the psalmody: "In my distress I cried unto the Lord" [Ps. 119; Kathisma 18]; Glory, both now, thrice, and 3 prostrations after each; and the priest says the Little Litany. After the psalmody we sing "Lord, I have cried" in the tone [of the week]; the troparia are in the Triodion; and we appoint 10 stichera, from "Bring my soul out of prison" [Ps. 141:8]: the Idiomelon of the day twice, and the Martyrikon in the same tone once; 3 Prosomoia in the Triodion, and of the Saint 3; and in the Menaion on 4, and the other twice; Glory, both now, Theotokion. Entrance with candles and with the censer, without the Gospel; "O Gladsome Light." Prokeimenon before the Old Testament reading, and Genesis is read. Another Prokeimenon; and the deacon exclaims: "Command!" (*κελεύσατε*)... ...Command!" (*κελεύσατε*).[^536] And the priest, having taken the censer and the candle in his right hand, stands before the Holy Table; and the deacon exclaims: "Wisdom! Let us attend!" And the priest, making the sign of the cross with the censer and with the candle, says: "The Light of Christ illumines all." Then the reader says: "The reading from Proverbs"; and the Proverbs of Solomon are read. The candle-lighter [kandilaptes] strikes the iron semantron [klepalo].[^537] And after the completion of the reading, the priest says: "Peace be unto thee"; and the singer begins: "Let my prayer be set forth [as incense before Thee]"; Verses: "Lord, I have cried unto Thee"; "Set, O Lord, a watch before my mouth"; "Incline not my heart [to evil words]" [Ps. 140:1–4]. And it takes place as follows: When the singer sings "Let my prayer be set forth," then we fall prostrate on our faces. But when we, having arisen, sing "Let my prayer be set forth," then the singer himself falls prostrate on his face. After this, the deacon [says] the litany: "Let us all say unto the Lord..."; and we make 3 prostrations. And the rest of the order of the Presanctified takes place. And after the Entrance...*

items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of Saint Theodore the Recruit [Tone 2]:* Great are the achievements of faith! In the fountain of flame, as upon the water of rest, the holy Martyr Theodore rejoiced; for having been consumed by fire, as sweet bread he was offered unto the Trinity. By his prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us![^545]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the Praises, Stichera of the Saint on 4; Glory, of the Saint; Both now, Theotokion. On the Aposticha, the Idiomela of the Saint in Tone 4; Glory, both now, of the Passion-bearer; Both now, Theotokion; and the First Hour. At the Liturgy: Beatitudes from the canon, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall be glad in the Lord" [Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear, O God, my voice" [Ps. 63:2]. Epistle to the Hebrews, pericope 313 [Heb. 1:1–12], and for the Saint [2 Tim. 2:1–10]; Alleluia: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [Ps. 91:13]. Gospel of Chrysostom [from Mark, pericope 10: Mark 2:23–3:5], and for the Saint... ...pericope 10 [Mark 2:23–3:5]; and for the Saint from John, pericope 52 [John 15:17–16:2]. Communion Hymn: "In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be" [Ps. 111:6].*

items.english_cohort_translation: *At Great Vespers: Stichera on 10: Resurrectional 6, and in the Triodion on 4; Glory, Tone 2: "Grace hath shone forth..."; Both now, Theotokion 1 of the tone. At the Entrance: the customary Prokeimenon. Glory, Tone 2: "Rejoice, O prophets..."; Both now, Theotokion. On the Aposticha: Resurrectional; Glory, Tone 2: "From ungodliness..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "Theotokos Virgin, rejoice..." twice; and "Thy most pure Icon..." once. At Matins: Troparion, Resurrectional, twice; Glory: "Thy most pure Icon..."; Both now, Theotokion; and the rest the customary order. Kathismata 3. Canons: Resurrectional on 4, and of the Theotokos on 4, and in the Triodion on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8:*"[^551]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion, Resurrectional, and in the Triodion. On the Praises, on 8: Resurrectional 3, and in the Triodion on 4; then 3: "Arise, O Lord my God" [Ps. 9:33]; Idiomelon, Tone 6: "Moses in the season of abstinence..."; Glory, the same; Both now: "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; and the Great Doxology. At the Liturgy: the Octoechos on 6, and in the Triodion, Ode 3. Prokeimenon: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers" [Dan. 3:26]; Verse: "For Thou art righteous in all that Thou hast done" [Dan. 3:27]. Epistle: "By faith Moses, when he was come to years..." [Heb. 11:24–26, 32–12:2]. Alleluia: "Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among them that call upon His name" [Ps. 98:6]. Gospel from John [1:43–51]: "The day following Jesus would go forth..." Communion Hymn: "Praise the Lord from the heavens" [Ps. 148:1]; and the other: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [Ps. 32:1].*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *The Third Sunday of the Fast, on which we celebrate the Veneration of the Precious Cross: At Great Vespers... ...Stichera on 10: Resurrectional 6, and of the Cross on 4; the tone of the Cross: Automelon 1. At the Entrance: Theotokion Dogmatikon of the tone; Glory, Tone 5: "Beholding Thee, O Christ, hanging upon the Tree..."; on the Aposticha: Resurrectional; Glory, Tone 4: "O Lord Who didst help gentle David..."; Both now, the same. Troparion: "Theotokos Virgin, rejoice..." twice; Tone 1: "Save, O Lord, Thy people..." once; this makes 3. At Matins: Troparion, Resurrectional twice; Glory, both now, of the Cross; and the rest the customary order. Canons: Resurrectional on 4, and of the Theotokos on 2, and of the Cross on 8; Katavasia: "Divine Moses prefigured of old...". After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the Cross. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 7, Automelon:*[^559]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Precious Cross [Tone 7]:* No longer doth the flaming sword guard the gate of Eden, for upon it hath come a marvelous bond, the Tree of the Cross! The sting of death and the victory of Hades have been destroyed, for Thou didst appear, O my Savior, crying unto those in faith: Enter ye again into Paradise!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion: Resurrectional, and of the Cross. On the Praises, appoint 8: 4 Resurrectional; and of the Cross, Prosomoia in Tone 4, on 4: 2 Prosomoia of the Cross are chanted with the 3 verses: "God is our King before the ages..." [Ps. 73:12]; Verse: "Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool..." [Ps. 98:5]. After this is said... ...another Resurrectional verse and the Prosomoia; and one sings the Idiomelon of the day in that tone, Tone 8: "The boast of the faithful..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Today the Cross of the Lord..."; Both now: "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; Great Doxology, sung in a quiet voice. After this Doxology, the priest vests in the phelonion, and comes with the censer and with a candle unto the Holy Table, and censes the Holy Table and the Precious Wood; and thus he lifts it upon his head, in his hands, upon a platter. And he goes by the left side of the altar, two great candles and the censer preceding him. He comes unto the church doors, and there stands awaiting the end of the Trisagion.*[^560] *And when the Trisagion is finished, the deacon says: "Wisdom! Let us attend!" And the brethren begin the Troparion: "Save, O Lord, Thy people...", chanting it thrice. And the priest comes, carrying the Precious Wood through the Holy Doors unto the prepared table, and places the Precious Wood upon the table. And thus...*

Повелѣнное таинъство прие̂мь въ разꋋмѣ . въ кровѣ їѡсифовѣ , скоро преста бесплътныи , гл̑а неискоусобрачьнѣи . преклонивыи нисхоженїе̂мь нб҃са . въмѣщаетсѧ неизмѣнновъвъта . егоже и ви дѧ въ ложеснѣ твои прїимша рабїи зракъ . оу̂жасаюсѧ зватити , радоуисѧ невѣсто неневѣстнаꙗ:~ ка̂ ҃з . двѣ . по ҃а . ка̂ ҃з . ко̂ гл҃а ҃и . въꙁбраннои . та̂ ико̂ . ҃ѕ . ѵпакои . ко̂ т҃о . е̂гда же , гл̑ютьсїа икоси . ц҃ы не сѣди , тогда . ностоꙗще слоушае̂мь съ страхо̂ . по ҃в . ка̂ . ко̂ . въꙁбраннои ко . и прочїі икосы ҃ѕ . и пакы кѡ҃ . то̂ . ѱло̂ . н҃ . кано̂ бц҃и не сѣдающаго . гл҃ ҃д . на ҃и . а прехрамоу на ҃ѕ . и йдеже . четверопѣц ино храмо̂ ѡложи . и бц҃и на ҃ѕ . по ҃г . пѣ кѡ҃ . въꙁбраннои . и икѡвь . ҃ѕ . и пакы тотъжь ко̂ . по ҃ѕ . пѣ четверопѣтна . по ѡбычаю . по ҃ѕ . пѣ кѡ҃ . въꙁбраннои . и икѡвь ҃ѕ . и пакы кѡ то̂ . и ико̂сь ҃а . по ҃ѳ . свѣ бц҃и . на хва . по̂бникы ьц҃и на ҃д . слава и ннѣ . ꙗзыка егоже . славословье . трори бц҃и . на лѵтоургїе . бл҃женна . ѡканона . бц҃и пѣ ҃г . и ҃ѕ . про велїчи дше моꙗ га̂

Повелѣнное таинъство прие̂мь въ разꋋмѣ . въ кровѣ їѡсифовѣ , скоро преста бесплътныи , гл̑а неискоусобрачьнѣи . преклонивыи нисхоженїе̂мь нб҃са . въмѣщаетсѧ неизмѣнновъвъта . егоже и ви дѧ въ ложеснѣ твои прїимша рабїи зракъ . оу̂жасаюсѧ зватити , радоуисѧ невѣсто неневѣстнаꙗ:~ ка̂ ҃з . двѣ . по ҃а . ка̂ ҃з . ко̂ гл҃а ҃и . въꙁбраннои . та̂ ико̂ . ҃ѕ . ѵпакои . ко̂ т҃о . е̂гда же , гл̑ютьсїа икоси . ц҃ы не сѣди , тогда . ностоꙗще слоушае̂мь съ страхо̂ . по ҃в . ка̂ . ко̂ . въꙁбраннои ко . и прочїі икосы ҃ѕ . и пакы кѡ҃ . то̂ . ѱло̂ . н҃ . кано̂ бц҃и не сѣдающаго . гл҃ ҃д . на ҃и . а прехрамоу на ҃ѕ . и йдеже . четверопѣц ино храмо̂ ѡложи . и бц҃и на ҃ѕ . по ҃г . пѣ кѡ҃ . въꙁбраннои . и икѡвь . ҃ѕ . и пакы тотъжь ко̂ . по ҃ѕ . пѣ четверопѣтна . по ѡбычаю . по ҃ѕ . пѣ кѡ҃ . въꙁбраннои . и икѡвь ҃ѕ . и пакы кѡ то̂ . и ико̂сь ҃а . по ҃ѳ . свѣ бц҃и . на хва . по̂бникы ьц҃и на ҃д . слава и ннѣ . ꙗзыка егоже . славословье . трори бц҃и . на лѵтоургїе . бл҃женна . ѡканона . бц҃и пѣ ҃г . и ҃ѕ . про велїчи дше моꙗ га̂
items.english_text: *Troparion of the Akathist [Tone 8]:* When the bodiless angel perceived the mystic command, he came with haste unto the abode of Joseph, and said unto her that knew not wedlock: He that bowed the heavens by His descent is held without change wholly within Thee; Whom also beholding Whom also beholding in Thy womb taking the form of a servant, in awe I cry unto Thee: Rejoice, O Bride unwedded!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Then the Ikos; and immediately the Beatitudes, and prostrations. Then also Ode 7, and the rest. Exapostilarion in the Octoechos. On the Aposticha: Idiomela of the day: 2, and of the day; Glory, Ikos 1; then without stichologia, then the Kathisma is chanted at Vespers. On Friday of the 5th week, at Vespers: Stichera on 10: Idiomela of the day: 2, and of the day; and of the holy Theotokos, Prosomoia 3, Tone 6, on 7: "The Pre-eternal Light..."; Glory, both now, Tone 2: "The mystery hidden from the ages..."; and the rest of the Presanctified Liturgy. Compline: Small Compline. On Saturday at Matins: Troparion thrice, Tone 8:*
items.office: On Cheesefare Sunday evening [Forgiveness Vespers]:*[^531]
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kathisma psalmody: two Kathismata. After the 1st Kathisma, Kontakion, Tone 8: "To thee, the Champion Leader..."; then 6 Ikoses; Hypakoe; the same Kontakion. And when these Ikoses are said, one does not sit down, but standing we listen with fear.*[^566] *After the 2nd Kathisma: Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader...", and the remaining 6 Ikoses, and again that same Kontakion. Psalm 50. Canon of the Theotokos, of the Akathist [non-sitting], Tone 4, on 8; and for the patron Saint of the church on 6; and where the Four-Ode Canon occurs, omit that of the church, and for the Theotokos on 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader...", and 6 Ikoses, and again that same Kontakion. After Ode 6, the Four-Ode Canon according to custom. After Ode 6, Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader...", and 6 Ikoses, and again that same Kontakion, and Ikos 1. After Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the Theotokos. On the Praises: Prosomoia of the Theotokos on 4; Glory, both now: "A language which she knew not..." [Tone 2]. Great Doxology; Troparion of the Theotokos. At the Liturgy: Beatitudes from the Canon of the Theotokos, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Savior" [Luke 1:46–47]... ...Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Luke 1:48]. Epistle: [Hebrews], pericope 320 [Heb. 9:1–7]: "For both He that sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one..." Alleluia: "Unto Thy face shall the rich among the people make supplication" [Ps. 44:13]. Gospel: [Luke], pericope 54 [Luke 1:39–49, 56]: "In those days, Mary arose..." Communion Hymn: "I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord" [Ps. 115:4].*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: В сꋋботоу , ст҃го лазарꙗ , на оу̂трни . тр҃о . гл҃а ҃а . ҃г . на б҃ъ гь , О̂бщее , въскресенїе прежде своеꙗ стр҃ти извѣщавь . йз мр҃твы , въскрѣсилъ е̂си лазарѧ хс҃е б҃же . тѣмь и мы ꙗко ѡтроци побѣдныꙗ ѡбразы , приносѧще , побѣдителю смр҃ти възъпїемь , ѡсанна въ вышнихъ , блгвнъ грѧдыи въ ймѧ гн҃е:~ по ҃в . ка̂ . по бл҃женни непорочни . тр҃ори . въскр̑ныи , а̂ггльскыи съборъ . и гледъ . въскресенїе хв҃о . ѱло̂ н҃ . кано̂ гл҃ ҃а . пѣнь побѣдноую . съерм̑ль . на ҃и . и инь . гл҃а ҃и . безъерм̑ло . на ҃ѕ . по ҃г . пѣсѣ празнй . по ҃ѕ . пѣ кѡ҃ . гл҃а , ҃в . Всѣхъ радос хс҃ истина свѣтъ и животъ . на мироу въздвиженїе . сꋋщимь на земли ꙗви сѧ своею блгтїю . въскресенїꙗ ѡбразъ бывь . и всѣмь подаꙗ въскрсенїе:~ свѣ . въ триѡ . на хва . самогл̑ны , ҃д . гл҃а ҃а . въскресенїе и жизнь . и два гл҃ д҃ . марѳа

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *And when the brethren kiss the Gospel, the Igumen distributes the palms, that is, the branches;*[^573] *and we begin the Canon, Tone 4: "The fountains of the deep were seen..." [composed by St. Cosmas]; the heirmos twice, and the troparia on 12; and again the heirmos once together [as Katavasia]. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 6:*
items.office: On Saturday of Saint Lazarus [Lazarus Saturday], at Matins: Troparion, Tone 1, thrice, at "God is the Lord":*[^568]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Егдаже братия цѣлують• еѵ̃ліе• раздаваеть игоуменъ• ваия• еже бѣтви• и начинаемь кано̃• гла̃ д̃• [я]вишася исто• ір̃мъ• по в̃• и тр̃ори• на, в̃і• и пакы• ір̃мъ• а̃• в коу̃• по ѕ̃• пѣ к̃о̃ гла̃ ѕ̃• На прѣстолѣ на нб̃си на жребяти на земли, сѣдяи х̃е б̃е• ѿ а̃г̃глъ хваленіе, и ѿ ѡ̃трокъ пѣніе пріймяше• въпіющих, блг̃венъ грядыи а̃дама възъдвигноути:~
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Palm Sunday [Tone 6]:* Borne upon a throne in heaven, and upon a foal on earth, O Christ God, Thou didst accept the praise of angels and the singing of children, who cried out: Blessed art Thou that comest to raise up Adam!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Candles are given unto the brethren; Exapostilarion thrice: ["Holy is the Lord our God"]. On the Praises: Stichera on 6: Idiomela 4, Tone 4: "And a great multitude...", "He that desired...", "The Creator...", "Giving assurance of the universal resurrection..."; Glory, both now, Tone 6: "Six days before the Passover..." Great Doxology, Troparion, and dismissal. Note: At the second hour of the day, we process with crosses around the monastery, and having returned, we begin the First Hour; and we celebrate the Liturgy earlier, on account of the labor.*[^574] *At the Liturgy: Festal Antiphons:*[^575] *Antiphon 1, Psalm [114]: "I have loved, because the Lord hath heard the voice of my supplication" [Ps. 114:1]; Refrain: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us"; Verse: ..."I have loved, because the Lord will hear the voice of my supplication; because He hath inclined His ear unto me" [Ps. 114:1–2]; Refrain: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos, Savior, save us"; Verse: "Therefore will I call upon Him in my days" [Ps. 114:2]; Refrain: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos..."; Verse: "The pangs of death encompassed me, the perils of Hades found me" [Ps. 114:3]; Refrain: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos, Savior, save us"; Glory: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos..."; Both now: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos..."*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: и пакы• ір̃мь• а̃• въкоупѣ• поемь• пѣ̃ни к̃о̃• гла̃ и̃• [я]ко начаткы• [Я]кѡ вьрыдаяше• іѡсифова лишеніа• [я]ко въ колесницѣ сѣдяше• на колесници [я]ко оурьчтоль• егѵптанынне ѡ̃сласти тогда не поработивься славляяше• И нынѣ славится ѡ̃ всевидящаго ч̃лчьская ср̃д̃ца• и посылающаго вѣнець ненетлѣнныи:~ с̃вѣ гла̃ и̃• Чертога твоего г̃• поетжеся• посре̃ цр̃кви• и пакы ѡ̃бою страноу• на хва̃• самогла̃ны• г̃• на д̃• единь• гла̃ а̃• Приходя г̃ь• е̃ два• е̃го• Постигше• г̃и гряди• сла̃ і н̃ гла̃ и̃• Исухъшьша• на сти̃• самогла̃ны• г̃• гла̃ е̃• Г̃и к таинъ• г̃и съкръши• постигше его• с̃ти же г̃лемь• Въспоите г̃ви• с̃ти• Видѣша въси• сла̃ і н̃ гла̃ и̃• И съвкоупляемь• а̃• ча̃• без стихословья• по обычаю• г̃, [я]же ча̃ ѕ̃• с̃ стихословьемь• въ свое время:~ на часѣх же• г̃лется• к̃о̃ д̃невн• трори• ѡ̃бычныя• Подобаеть вѣдати• како, чести тетро• еѵ̃ліе• Иже ѿ ма̃а̃• еѵ̃ліе• чтется на два• ч̃теня все• тако̃• и ѿ марка• вьсе надвое• И еже ѿ лоу̃• чтется на г̃• ч̃теня• И еже ѡ̃ іѡ̃а• чтется• до начала ст̃ыя страстеи• на два• ч̃теня• Чтоут же еѵ̃ліа, въ три д̃ни• в п̃не• въ в̃то• въ ср̃е• на г̃• ѕ̃• и ѳ̃• мь часѣ• Въ ст̃ыи великыи, в п̃не• вечерь• с̃тры• на ѕ̃• Итыя оутрѣ• с̃л і н̃• гла̃ и̃• Второую еввоу• въхо̃• съ еѵ̃ліемь ч̃тене• парміи• Да ся исправить мл̃итва, т̃а еѵ̃ліе• ѿ ма̃а̃• Сѣдящю іс̃оу на горѣ• и екте̃я• Ръцѣмь вьси• и прое• слоужба• прежес̃щен̃ны• и въходимь въ трапезу• [я]мы соухояденіе• т̃аи до великаго, четвертка• павечерница же поется великаа по ѡ̃бычаю• на неи же тр̃ипѣсна г̃на а̃ндреа Въ в̃то• великыи• на оу̃р, пое• а̃ллилуа• въ гла̃ и̃• и г̃лемь• тр̃о• г̃• Се жени грядеть [Кустод: о̃б]
items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion, Tone 8: "Thy Bridal Chamber, O Lord, I behold adorned, and a garment I have not that I may enter therein; enlighten the vesture of my soul, O Giver of Light, and save me", chanted thrice in the midst of the church, and again by both sides [choirs].*[^582] *On the Praises: Idiomela 3, on 4: one in Tone 1: "The Lord, going unto His voluntary Passion..."; and the other two: "Having reached the saving Passion...", "Lord, coming unto Thy Passion..."; Glory, both now, Tone 8: "Finding the fig tree withered [because of its barrenness]..." On the Aposticha: Idiomela 3, Tone 5: "Lord, reaching the mystery...", "Lord, Thou hast crushed...", "Having reached..."; and we say the verses: "Sing unto the Lord a new song" [Ps. 97:1]; Verse: "All the ends of the earth have seen" [Ps. 97:3]; Glory, both now, Tone 8: ["A second Eve the serpent found in the Egyptian woman..."]. And we join the First Hour, without stichologia, according to custom; but the Third and Sixth Hours with stichologia at their proper time. At the Hours, moreover, there is said the Kontakion of the day, and the troparia... ...the customary ones. It is fitting to know how the Four Gospels [Tetraevangelion] are read:*[^583] *The Gospel of Matthew is read entirely in two readings; likewise also that of Mark, entirely in two; and that of Luke is read in three readings; and that of John is read up to the beginning of the Holy Passion in two readings. And they read the Gospels during the three days: on Monday, on Tuesday, and on Wednesday, at the Third, Sixth, and Ninth Hours.*

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Great Wednesday [Tone 4]:* Having transgressed more than the harlot, O Compassionate One, I have never offered Thee streams of tears; but in silence, praying, I fall down before Thee, desiring with love to kiss Thine all-pure feet, that Thou, as Master, mayest grant forgiveness of debts unto me who cry out: O Savior, deliver me from my filthy deeds!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of Great Thursday, Tone 8:* When the glorious disciples at the washing of the Supper were enlightened, then Judas the ungodly, stricken with the love of silver, was darkened, and to the lawless judges surrenders Thee, the righteous Judge. Behold, thou lover of possessions, him who on their account hanged himself! Flee the insatiable soul which dared such things against the Teacher! O Lord Who art good towards all, glory to Thee!

Only was the Tree of Thy Cross planted, O Christ, and the foundations of death were shaken, O Lord; for Him whom Hades swallowed eagerly, he released with trembling: Thou hast revealed Thy salvation unto us, O Holy One; we glorify Thee, O Savior, O God, have mercy on us!

items.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: Litany, and Dismissal. And we do not join the First Hour.*[^600]
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Holy and Great Saturday: at the 7th hour of the night, we strike the iron semantron, and begin Matins: "God is the Lord" in Tone 2, and we chant Troparion, Tone 2, thrice: "The noble Joseph..."; Glory: "When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal..."; Both now: "Unto the Myrrh-bearing women, the Angel standing by the tomb cried..."; Stichologia: "Blessed are the undefiled in the way" [Psalm 118], in tone... ...with refrains [Lamentations at the Tomb], in 3 Stases:*[^604] *after the 1st Stasis, the priest censes; and after the 3rd Stasis, there are sung the Resurrectional Troparia, Tone 5: "The angelic council was amazed..." Little Litany; then Sessional hymns of this day; after the reading, "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" is NOT said, but immediately Psalm 50. Canon in Tone 6: "By a wave of the sea...":*[^605] *the heirmos twice, and the troparia on 4; and again the heirmos once together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn, Tone 1: "Thy tomb, O Savior..."; Glory, both now, the same. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, Automelon: "He Who did not seek handwriting...":*
items.office: Litany, and Dismissal. And we do not join the First Hour.*[^600]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Holy Saturday [Tone 2]:*[^606] He Who shut up the abyss is beheld dead; and wrapped in myrrh and fine linen [the Holy Shroud], the Immortal One is laid in a tomb as one dead. And the women came to anoint Him with myrrh, weeping bitterly and crying: This is the most blessed Sabbath, on which Christ, having fallen asleep, shall rise on the third day!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos: "In the brightness of Thy saints..." On the Praises: Idiomela 4, Tone 2: "Today He Who holds [creation] in His palm...", "What is this sight that is beheld...", "Come, behold [our Life lying in the tomb]..."; and another in Tone 6... ...and: "Joseph went in and asked for the Body of Jesus..." Glory, Tone 6: "Today secretly the great Moses prefigured this day..."; Both now: "Most blessed art Thou, [O Virgin Theotokos...]"; Great Doxology. The priest vests in full sacerdotal vestments;*[^607] *and he makes the Entrance with the Holy Gospel; he comes before the Holy Doors, and there stands awaiting the end of the Trisagion; and when the Trisagion is finished, he exclaims: "Wisdom. Stand upright." And they chant the Troparion: "The noble Joseph..." Then the priest enters: "Peace be unto all." Then the Paremia Troparion, Tone 4: "He Who holds the ends of the earth..."; then the Paremia of the day [Ezek. 37:1–14]; Prokeimenon before the Apostle: "Arise, O Lord my God, let Thine hand be lifted up; forget not Thy poor for ever" [Ps. 9:33 (10:12)]; Verse: "I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart" [Ps. 9:1]; Epistle to the Romans [sic; 1 Cor. 5:6–8]: "A little leaven leavens the whole lump..."; Alleluia: "Let God arise, and let His enemies be scattered" [Ps. 67:1]; Verse: "As smoke vanishes, so let them vanish" [Ps. 67:2]; Verse: "So let the wicked perish at the presence of God" [Ps. 67:2]; Gospel according to Matthew [Matt. 27:62–66]. At Matins, following the Gospel: Litany: "Let us all say...", and "Let us complete our morning prayer...", and the Dismissal.*

items.english_cohort_translation: *And he sings the Heirmos:* "Shine, shine, O new Jerusalem, for the glory of the Lord hath shone upon thee! Dance now and be glad, O Zion, and do thou exult, O pure Theotokos, in the arising of Thy Child!"; *then the troparia of Ode 9; and again after:* "Shine, shine"; *and the brethren kiss the prosphora, all in order. After this, the cellarer returns with the Artos and places it before the Hegumen; and the priest says:* "Through the prayers of our holy fathers..."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ сꙋботꙋ же , ѳ҃ , ѡ҃диноу · раздроблѧ́ ють , а҆́ртоусъ · и҆ раздавають · братїи :~
items.english_cohort_translation: *The priest vests in sacred vestments... ...and standing before the Holy Doors with the censer, he censes the Holy Doors in the form of a cross, saying:* "Blessed is our God..."; *and after "Amen", he begins: "Christ is risen" (thrice); then it is also sung by the brethren (thrice); and the priest says the verses: "Let God arise"; Verse: "As smoke vanishes"; Verse: "So let the wicked perish"; and after each verse the brethren sing: "Christ is risen"; Glory, Both now: "Christ is risen". Great Litany. At "Lord, I have cried", in Tone 2: Stichera, 3 Resurrectional and 3 Anatolian of Tone 2; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion, Tone 1:* "The shadow of the Law hath passed away, now that grace hath come; for as the Bush was not consumed though on fire, so hast thou given birth as a virgin and remained a virgin. In place of the pillar of fire, the Sun of Righteousness hath shone forth; instead of Moses, Christ, the salvation of our souls."[^653] *Entrance with the Holy Gospel; "O Joyful Light"; then the Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7:* "Who is a god so great as our God? Thou art the God that doest wonders!" [Ps. 76:14–15][^654] *Verse 1: "Thou hast declared Thy power among the peoples" [Ps. 76:15]; Verse 2: "And I said: Now have I begun" [Ps. 76:11]; Verse 3: "I remembered the works of the Lord" [Ps. 76:12]; then the priest:* "And that we may be accounted worthy..."; *and he reads the Gospel according to John [20:19–25]: "The same day at evening..." ending with: "...I will not believe."*[^655] *Litany: "Let us all say..."; "Vouchsafe, O Lord..."; then the Litany: "Let us complete our evening prayer..."; Aposticha: Resurrectional:* "Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, hath enlightened the whole universe; and Thou hast recalled Thine own creation: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!"; *then 3 Stichera of Pascha...*[^656]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ пакы і҃рм̃ь а҃ · вкоу · Въ началѣ же кано на · і҃ереи кадить цр҃ковь · по г҃ · пѣ̃ ѵ҆па кои · та̃ · і҃рм̃ь · по ѕ҃ ко̃ і҃ико · та̃ въскръ сенїе х҃во , г҃ · и҆ въскресыи ѡ҃ гроба · безъ п҃ го · ѱалма · по ѳ҃ · пѣ̃ · свѣ́, г҃ · на хва́ ·
items.english_cohort_translation: *The priest puts on the epitrachelion, and taking the censer, censes the Holy Table thrice in the sign of the cross, saying:* "Glory to the holy, consubstantial..."; *and after "Amen", the priest begins: "Christ is risen" (thrice), and censes the altar, the brethren singing: "Christ is risen" (thrice); and the priest says 3 verses: "O give thanks unto the Lord" [Ps. 117:1]; "This is the day which the Lord hath made" [Ps. 117:24]; "Bind the sacrifice with cords" [Ps. 117:27]; at each verse: "Christ is risen"; and again the priest: "Christ is risen"; the brethren: "And upon those in the tombs bestowing life!" Great Litany. After the exclamation, we begin the Canon:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; *the Heirmos twice, and the troparia on 4, and again the Heirmos once together. At the beginning of the Canon the priest censes the church. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe, then the Heirmos; after Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos, then the Resurrectional hymn... ..."Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (thrice); and "Jesus having risen from the tomb", without the 50th Psalm.*[^660] *After Ode 9, the Exapostilarion (thrice); at the Praises: Stichera of the Octoechos of Tone 2 on 4; then the Paschal Stichera: "Pascha the sacred"; Glory, Both now:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; *then "Christ is risen" (thrice); Litany, and Dismissal; and they process with crosses around the monastery. In this manner it is sung also at Matins throughout all the week.*[^661]

items.english_cohort_translation: *At "Lord, I have cried", in Tone 4, Stichera of the Octoechos: 3 Resurrectional and 3 Anatolian; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion of Tone 1 [Tone 4 Dogmatikon]:* "David the Prophet, who through thee became the forefather of God, in song cried out concerning thee unto Him that did great things for thee: 'The Queen stood at Thy right hand...' [Ps. 76:2][^671]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Stichera, 3 Resurrectional of Tone 5 and 3 Anatolian; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion of the Tone [Tone 5 Dogmatikon]:* "In the Red Sea an image of the unwedded Bride was prefigured of old: there Moses divided the water, here Gabriel was the minister of the marvel; then the deep was trodden dry-shod by Israel, now Christ is born without seed of the Virgin; the sea after the passage of Israel remained impassable, the Immaculate One after the birth of Emmanuel remains undefiled..."[^677] *Entrance; Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7:* Give ear, O God, unto my prayer, and despise not my supplication! [Ps. 54:2][^678]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · Г҃ь въцр̃исѧ · с҃ · и҆́бо оу҆твръди е҆ѵлїе рж҃ · при Тѣ́ло х҃во · На трапезѣ , сѣ́ кши бра̃и , раздробивъ келарь , а҆́ртоу и҆ дае ть бра̃и · Х҃с же въскрсе , възглашаетсѧ в конець трапезы · и҆ ѡ҃всегда · ѿ нн҃ѣ́ даже и҆ до възнесенїа · въ мѣ́стѣ́ , великомїа · Се моу же гл̃емомꙋ · ѿ келарѧ · мы гле̃мь ѡ҃ вѣ́щеваа · Въистинноу въскрсе · та̃ кела рь · прекрщ҃аѧ · панагыю · хлѣ́бомь речеть · Пр҃таа бц҃е помагаи намь · мы же ѡ҃вѣ́щаемь · Тоꙗ мл҃твами б҃е помилꙋи на̃ ·
items.english_cohort_translation: *At the Refectory [trapeza]: The brethren having sat down, the cellarer having broken the Artos, distributes it unto the brethren.*[^699] *"Christ is risen" is proclaimed at the end of the refectory, and always from now even unto the Ascension, in place of "Great is the Name [of the Holy Trinity]".*[^700] *And when this is said by the cellarer, we say responding:* "Truly He is risen!" *Then the cellarer, crossing the panagia with the bread, says:* "All-holy Theotokos, help us!" *And we... ...respond:* "By her prayers, O God, have mercy on us!"[^701] *Then:* "All generations call thee blessed", *and the rest of the customary order.*[^702]

items.english_cohort_translation: *The priest having blessed, we say:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [Ps. 103]; *Stichera, 4 of the New Sunday [Thomas Sunday], Tone 1:* "When the doors were shut..."[^704] *Glory, Both now, Tone 6:* "When the doors were shut, Jesus came unto the disciples..." *At the Aposticha, idiomela in Tone 4:* "O marvelous wonder! Lack of faith hath begotten firm faith..."[^705] *Verses; Glory, Both now, Tone 5:* "O Lover of mankind, great and unsearchable is the multitude of Thy compassions..." *Troparion, Tone 7:* "Though the tomb was sealed...", *and Dismissal.*

internal_coordinates.podoben_label_raw: With his searching right hand did Thomas explore Thy life-giving side, O Christ God; for when Thou didst enter, the doors being shut, he cried aloud with the rest of the Apostles: Thou art my Lord and my God![^711] *Ikos; after Ode 9:* "More honorable than the Cherubim" *is not sung, and we do not chant the verses of the Ninth Ode.*[^712] *Exapostilarion, Tone 3:* "With thy hand having probed the wounds of My members, Thomas, be not faithless unto Me..."[^713] *At the Praises, Stichera on 4, Tone 1, Podoben: "All-praised martyrs" (Всехвалніи мученицы):*[^714] *Glory, Tone 6:* "After eight days our Savior came unto the disciples..."; *Both now:* "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast, and Dismissal.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: въскр̃ны · покаꙗнны · и҆ дл҃ · сл̃ і҃ н҃ праз̃ · на стї ст҃ры праз̃ · и҆́же въ триѡ҃ · с҃ тї же гле̃ ды · въ всю зелю · с҃ · нб҃са повѣ́даю · сл̃а і҃ н҃ праз̃ · по тр҃тѣмь · тро̃ праз̃ · і҃ере̃и ѡ҃кте̃ю · та̃ і҃ереи · Сын бл̃агословень б҃ъ нашь · и҆ съвъкоуплꙗе̃ · а҃ ча̃ · по ѡ҃быю ·
items.english_cohort_translation: *On Monday of Antipascha [Second Monday after Pascha], at Matins: The usual Midnight Office. Then the priest having blessed, we begin:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory to God in the highest", *and the Six Psalms. And at* "God is the Lord": *Troparion of the feast, thrice; and chant two Kathismata. After the 1st Kathisma: Sessional hymns from the Octoechos, Resurrectional and Penitential, and of the day; Glory, Both now. After the 2nd Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the feast;* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"; *Psalm 50; but the Hymns [of repentance: "Open unto me the doors of repentance..."] are not said throughout the whole Fifty Days [Pentecostarion period]. And straightway we begin [the Canon]: the Heirmos twice, and troparia to 6, and of the Triodion/saint to 4. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the day; after Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast; after Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the feast. At the Praises: Resurrectional, Penitential, and of the day; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: Stichera of the feast, which are in the Triodion; and we say the verses:* Their sound is gone out into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world! [Ps. 18:5][^722] *Verse:* The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament proclaims the work of His hands! [Ps. 18:2] *Glory, Both now, of the feast. After the Trisagion: Troparion of the feast. The priest says the Ektenia. Then the priest [gives the dismissal/blessing]:* "Blessed is the Son of God, our God", *and he joins the First Hour according to custom.*[^723]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Be it known that from this day we begin... ...to chant the Psalter: two Kathismata at Matins, and the third at Vespers in order.*[^724] *And from now on we begin to chant the Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos at Compline, the daily canons in the Triodion.*[^725] *At the beginning of every singing [office], the priest having blessed, we say:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory, Both now", "All-holy Trinity", *and* "Our Father", *and the rest as usual.*[^726] *Likewise even until the Day of the Ascension, in the same manner. And at Matins, after the second litany is said:* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ", *even until the Ascension of the Lord.*[^727] *And this is to be known: Even as it hath been indicated on Sunday evening and on Monday at Matins, so it is done throughout all the weeks, even until the Ascension, with the stichera changing according to the Tones in the Octoechos, and the Sessional hymns according to custom.*[^728] *Be it known also that on Wednesday and on Friday, the Stichera of the Cross are sung first; thus: the Resurrectional are not first, because our Lord Jesus Christ was first crucified...*

items.english_cohort_translation: *On Friday of Antipascha [Second Friday of Paschaltide, Apodosis of Thomas Sunday], at Vespers: Stichera on 6: of the feast, idiomela 3 in Tone 1; and of the day, 3; Glory, Tone 6:* "When the doors were shut..."; *Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion of Tone 1:* "The glory of all the world, who sprouted from mankind..."[^730] *At the Aposticha: 4 Resurrectional of Tone 1; and we say the verses:* The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty! [Ps. 92:1a] *Verse:* For He hath established the world, which shall not be shaken! [Ps. 92:1c] *Verse:* Holiness becomes Thine house, O Lord, unto length of days! [Ps. 92:5b] *Glory, Both now, Tone 5:* "O Lover of mankind, great and unsearchable..."; *Troparion, Tone 7:* "Though the tomb was sealed..."; *the Canon for the Departed in the Octoechos of the current Tone.*[^731] *On all Saturdays of the Fifty Days is sung [the Canon for the Departed] on Friday at Compline. On Saturday at Matins: Troparion of the feast, thrice; Sessional hymns in the Triodion of the feast; Canon of the feast with the heirmoi on 6, and of the patron saint of the temple in Tone 1 on 4; or if there be no patronal service, then of the Prophets; or of the Saint [from the Menaion] on 4.*[^732] *At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional of Tone 1; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon of the feast; Alleluia, Communion verse of the feast; but the Epistle and Gospel of the day.*[^733]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Stichera: Resurrectional and of the Theotokos according to custom. Troparion:* "The noble Joseph..." *At Great Vespers: ...Stichera on 10: Resurrectional 3 from the Octoechos of Tone 2, and Anatolian 4; and of the Myrrh-Bearers, idiomela 3 in Tone 2; Glory, Tone 6:* "The Myrrh-bearing women, reaching Thy sepulchre early...";[^735] *Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion of Tone 2:* "Passed away is the shadow of the law when grace arrived..."[^736] *At the Litiya: idiomela 3 in Tone 1; Glory, Tone 6:* "Joseph begged the Body of Jesus..."; *Both now, Theotokion of the same Tone [or Alphabetical Theotokion]. items.slavonic_diplomatic: кѡ̃ гл̃ в҃ · Радоватисѧ мироносицамъ повелѣ́лъ е҆си · и҆ плачь прама́трери е҆́вы · оу҆ ставилъ е҆си въскренїе̃ своимь · х҃е б҃е нашь а҆́пл҃ѡм же своимь проповѣ́дати повелѣ́ · сп҃съ въскре̃ ѡ҃ гроба :~
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst bid the myrrh-bearing women rejoice, and didst stay the weeping of the first-mother Eve by Thy Resurrection, O Christ our God; and Thou didst command Thine Apostles to proclaim: The Savior is risen from the tomb![^743]

ставилъ е҆си въскренїе̃ своимь · х҃е б҃е нашь
а҆́пл҃ѡм же своимь проповѣ́дати повелѣ́ · сп҃съ

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въхо̃ же ѿ селѣ́ въ нѣ́лю , не бываетъ · и҆ въ пн҃е нѣ̃ · на оу҆рни · ꙗ҆́ко и҆ в пн҃е · а҃нтипасхы · На сти · ст҃ры праз̃ · с҃тї же гле̃мь · Бл҃гово лилъ е҆си г҃и землю · с҃ Мл҃ть и҆ и҆́стина · Сл̃а і҃ны праз̃ · Въ пн҃е · г҃ нѣ̃ · ве̃рь · ꙗ҆́коже и҆ в пн҃ · в҃ ·
items.english_cohort_translation: *On the 3rd Sunday evening [Third Sunday of Pascha, at Vespers]: Even as on the Sunday of Antipascha. But the Entrance from now on Sunday [evening] does not take place.*[^750] *And on Monday... ...at Matins: As also on Monday of Antipascha. At the Aposticha: Stichera of the feast, and we say the verses:* Lord, Thou hast been favorable unto Thy land! [Ps. 84:2] *Verse:* Mercy and truth are met together! [Ps. 84:11] *Glory, Both now, of the feast. On Monday evening of the 3rd Week: Even as indicated for Monday of the 2nd Week, with changing stichera and troparia. On Saturday at Matins: As on Saturday of Antipascha.*[^751] *At the Liturgy: Ode 9 of the feast with the heirmoi on 6; Prokeimenon, Alleluia of the feast; but the Epistle and Gospel, and Communion verse, of the day.*[^752]

items.english_cohort_translation: The feast of the Law being at the midst, O Creator and Master of all, Thou didst say unto them that were present, O Christ God: Come and draw the water of immortality! Therefore do we fall down before Thee and cry aloud in faith: Grant unto us Thy compassions, for Thou art the Fountain of our life![^767]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вѣрѣ пришедши на кладазь , самарѣныни оузрѣвши , иже прⷣмодрости воды , и҆ текє на- пившисѧ хє҃ ѡбилно · нцрⷵтвїа вышнѣго на- слѣдовавши , вѣчно ꙗко прнославнаа: ~ чт҃нѣишю не стислови · свѣ п҃лою оуснꙋвъ и҆ ѡ самарѣны · на хва҃ д҃ въскрн҃ и҆ всто҃ а҃ и҆ ѡ самарѣныі еди҃ гл҃ г҃ в҃ в҃ го гл҃ · сла҃ ѕ҃ источни і҆ н҃ преблгⷵвена · сласлое тро҃ воскрн҃ токмо на лѵр҃ ѡби праз҃ пѣ г҃ ѕ самарѣни про по- ите б҃ꙋ на · с҃ вси ꙗꙁыци а҆пл҃ р҃д а҆ллꙋна ·

items.english_cohort_translation: *On Wednesday [Apodosis of Mid-Pentecost], at Matins:*[^781] *Troparion of the feast, thrice; Sessional hymns of the feast; two canons of the feast: one with the heirmoi on 8, and the other without heirmoi on 6; Katavasia:* "The sea curdled" [Tone 4];[^782] *at the Praises: of the feast on 4; Glory, Both now:* "Having been enlightened..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast; Dismissal. At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the feast from both canons, from Ode 9 with the heirmoi on 8; Troparion and Kontakion of the feast; Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion verse of the feast; but the Epistle and Gospel of the day.*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: на ѕ҃ · по г҃ пѣⷵни ко҃ ѡ҃це гл҃ и҃ · А҆плⷵское преданїе · и҆ ѡ҃цъ ꙁаповѣданїе , цр҃кы є҆ди ною вѣрою ꙋ҃твръди · и҆ риꙁоу носѧщи не тлѣннꙋ · и҆стъканꙋ съквыше бг҃ословеснѣ правити и҆ славити · бл҃гочⷵтї великаꙗ та инꙋ : ~ чт҃нѣишꙋ не стїхслови · свѣ праꙁ и҆ ѡ҃цмь нахва҃ · стры д҃ · въскрⷵны · и҆ ѡ҃це мь · на д҃ · по҃ гл҃ ѕ҃ · все ꙋ҃пованїе · сл҃а ·

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Monday at Matins after the commemoration of All Saints:*[^854] *Customary Kathismata two, and Sessional hymns in the Octoechos; Canons 3: in the Octoechos 2, and the third of the day; counting also the heirmoi, hold 12 troparia, besides Glory and Both now; the rest customary according to the complete order.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
items.section: On Monday at Matins after the commemoration of All Saints:* *Customary Kathismata two, and Sessional hymns in the Octoechos; Canons 3: in the Octoechos 2, and the third of the day; counting also the heirmoi, hold 12 troparia, besides Glory and Both now; the rest customary according to the complete order.
items.english_cohort_translation: *The Hours, when "Alleluia" is [chanted], are chanted thus:*[^855] *At the end of the 2nd hour, having gathered in the narthex, we chant the 3rd Hour: 3 Psalms; at "Glory": 3 prostrations; then:* "O Lord, Who didst send down Thy Most Holy Spirit at the third hour upon Thine Apostles, take Him not from us, O Good One, but renew Him within us who pray unto Thee", *recited simply without singing, with its verses; Glory, Both now:* "Blessed is the Lord God..."; *and Trisagion; and the customary troparia, and the prayer, and 15 prostrations.*

items.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *And following the Inter-Hours, then the 3rd, and 6th, and 9th; after this the Beatitudes are said; Epistle and Gospel of the day; and the rest of the service, and Dismissal.*[^856] *Having remained quiet for a little while in the cells, and the time having arrived, he strikes the great semantron; and having gathered into church, we chant Vespers: after the Kathisma, "Lord, I have cried" in the tone of the day; we chant stichera on 6; Glory, Both now, Theotokion; and if there is an idiomelon, it is chanted at Glory; Troparion of the Saint or of the day, and Theotokion, and Dismissal.*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: сѣⷣ к дн҃и · и҆ по ѕ҃ · мл҃ · в ъ ѡ҃ и҆ ко҃ · каnѡна в҃ въ ѡ҃ · и҆ в длинен на д҃і · е҆тиховь всѣхъ и҆ чт҃е а҃ хва · и҆ ст҃ры не поє · н҃ ж по слава въ вышни · на сти · в ъ ѡ҃ · и҆ стї гл҃емь и҆ сплъ нихомсѧ · и҆ бꙋди свѣтлость · с҃ лл і҆ н҃ ко҃ нчїа а҃ п ѡ ѡ҃быю · е҆гда же е҆ а҆ллꙋуа · поєма а҆мь ча҃ ꙁа ꙋ҃тра ѡ҃услыши · съ ст҃и є҆го · по скоро ѡ҃укалика · и҆ с поклоны великаго по ·
items.english_cohort_translation: *In the morning at "God is the Lord" we chant the Troparion of the Saint and of that day; if he hath none, we recite a podoben unto him; and Kathismata 2; and Sessional hymns in the Octoechos; after Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the day; and after Ode 6: Martyrikon in the Octoechos and Kontakion; Canons 2 in the Octoechos, and of the day, making 14 troparia in all; and Reading 1 of the Praises; and stichera are not chanted, but after "Glory to God in the highest" [Doxology], at the Aposticha in the Octoechos, and we recite the verses; and* "We have been filled [in the morning with Thy mercy]" [Ps. 89:14], *and* "And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us" [Ps. 89:17]; *Trisagion; Glory, Both now, Kontakion... ...and the First Hour according to custom. When "Alleluia" is [chanted], we chant at the [First] Hour:* "In the morning hear my voice, [my King and my God]" [Ps. 5:4], *with its verses; thereafter the customary prayer [of St. Ephrem] with the prostrations of the Great Fast;*[^858] *and the Hours having been completed, he strikes the small semantron, and we chant the 3rd and 6th Hours in the narthex with the Inter-Hours. And thereafter he strikes the great semantron, and begins the Liturgy, the priest having beforehand prepared according to custom.*

items.english_cohort_translation: *After the Dismissal of the Liturgy, if there is eating on that day, we go out unto the refectory, and eat whatever God hath granted. If there is a fast and prostrations, he gives a portion [antidoron] to the priest, and the paraklesiarches [gives] warm water.*[^860] *After the Dismissal of the Liturgy, having sat a little while, until the consumption of the Holy Gifts; and thereafter each departs unto his own cell, remaining silent until the time of the ninth hour. And the time having arrived... ...of it, he strikes the small semantron; and having gathered into church, we chant the [Ninth] Hour with the rest of the order of that hour, and with 15 prostrations.*[^861] *After this he strikes the great semantron, and we chant Vespers: Kathisma 18; stichera; and in place of the prokeimenon: "Alleluia" in Tone 6; if it is not "God is the Lord", at the Aposticha in the Octoechos; Troparia:* "Theotokos Virgin, rejoice..." *simply, and the rest; and Dismissal.*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Г҃н и҆ꙁбавлен · наченшꙋ жє їєрею · гл҃едь пр҃те поклонимсѧ · та҃ ѱа҃ лѡ҃ · н҃ · и҆ а҆бїе каnѡ бц҃и · и҆ проꙗ попе · ѱа҃лмы ѡ҃бычны · и҆ на коне ѱа҃лѡ · е҃і · по чиноую · и҆ до пр҃тѣи бц҃и · и҆ по слѣ не тр҃тое · и҆ до є҆же поває починати прѣ стателю · и҆ лиеклисиаⷬхоу · и҆ ѡ҃поустъ и҆ прѣклоненне к настоꙗтелю прости те
items.english_cohort_translation: *And at Compline: Having risen from the refectory, and rested a little, he strikes the small semantron; having gathered in the church narthex, we chant Compline: the Six Psalms; and if "Alleluia" is [chanted], we make prostrations, reciting this individually; and the rest: prayer:* "O Lord our Deliverer..."; *the priest having begun, we say:* "O come, let us worship...", *then Psalm 50; and immediately the Canon of the Theotokos; and the rest of the chanting: customary Psalms; and at the end 15 Psalms in order; and unto the Most Pure Theotokos; and after this the Trisagion; and unto that which the superior and the ekklesiarches ought to begin; and the Dismissal, and bowing before the superior:* "Forgive..."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Чьстное прⷪркъ твоихъ торжество • нб҃о цр҃квы показа • агг҃ли съ чл҃кы ликоують • тѣхъ мл҃твами въ мирѣ оуправи жизнь нашѫ • да поетъ сѧ аллилуіа :~
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The precious festival of Thy prophets hath shown the Church to be heaven: angels dance with men; by their prayers guide our life in peace, that there may be sung: Alleluia![^1237]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Надеже мироу бл҃гословєнаа бц҃е дв҃о • твоє єдино застоуплениє страшноє подвизаємъ оумилрⷣи сѧ на беспомощныи люди • и моли милостиваго б҃а • избавити сѧ доушамъ нашимъ ѿ въсѧкого прегрѣшениа єдина бл҃гвенаа :~
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O Hope of the world, blessed Theotokos Virgin: we urge Thine only fearsome intercession; have compassion upon a helpless people, and pray the merciful God that our souls may be delivered from every transgression, O Thou who alone art blessed![^1238]
